import re

SQL_QUERY = (
    "SELECT * "
    "FROM premium_accounts "
    "WHERE id = %s"
)

URL = "https://example.com/api/v1/accounts"
LOCAL_PATH = "/etc/codekavach/config.toml"
GREETING = "Hello, {name}! You have {count} new messages."
PATTERN = re.compile(r"^[a-z0-9_]+$")
NATURAL_TEXT = "the quarterly report is attached for review"


def run_query(cursor, account_id):
    cursor.execute("SELECT balance FROM accounts WHERE id = %s" % account_id)
